title: trust.rs: schnorr48-dependent functions missing feature gate
description:
Lines 143-157 (verify_key_rotation) and 175-189 (verify_slot_claim) call schnorr48::verify but schnorr48 is an optional dependency (feature = 'schnorr'). These functions will cause compilation errors when the schnorr feature is not enabled.

Fix: Wrap both functions with #[cfg(feature = "schnorr")]
close_reason: Not a bug: trust.rs module is already gated by #[cfg(feature = "schnorr")] at module level in lib.rs (lines 62-63). Verified: cargo check succeeds both with and without schnorr feature.
